name: read_file
description: Read a file in the remote Workspace. Read before editing an existing file.

file_path.description: Path relative to the saved Session working directory in its remote Workspace. Never use the Harness host path.

name: write_file
description: Write a file in the remote Workspace. Read before overwriting an existing file. Write/Edit preimages are backed up. External or Shell changes to tracked content or permissions block further Write/Edit in the same prompt and block undo. A new Write/Edit prompt must validate a fresh backup before accepting those changes.

file_path.description: Path relative to the saved Session working directory in its remote Workspace. Never use the Harness host path.

name: edit
description: Replace exact text in a remote Workspace file that you have read. Write/Edit preimages are backed up. External or Shell changes to tracked content or permissions block further Write/Edit in the same prompt and block undo. A new Write/Edit prompt must validate a fresh backup before accepting those changes.

file_path.description: Path relative to the saved Session working directory in its remote Workspace. Never use the Harness host path.
